To optimize the **GirviGold Ledger** for a **Netlify** production environment, we need to ensure the app handles client-side routing logic (preventing 404s on refresh), implements secure headers, and provides a high-quality Progressive Web App (PWA) experience.

payload.text:
### Steps to Deploy on Vercel:
1.  **Push your code** to a GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket repository.
2.  Go to [vercel.com](https://vercel.com) and click **"New Project"**.
3.  Import your repository.
4.  Vercel will automatically detect the `vercel.json` and `index.html`.
5.  Under **Framework Preset**, select **"Other"** (Vercel will treat it as a high-performance static site).
6.  Click **Deploy**.

The app is now "Vercel-friendly," meaning it handles deep-linking, security headers, and caching properly!
